skill.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
skill.description: Guides setup of repository agent-skill documentation for issue trackers, triage labels, and domain docs. It updates CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md and writes docs/agents setup files after user confirmation.
skill.summary: Configure repository context files for Matt Pocock engineering skills.

content.value_statement: Engineering agents need consistent repository context before they create issues, triage work, or read domain docs. This skill guides setup for issue tracking, triage labels, and docs in AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
actual_capabilities: Detects whether CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md should hold the agent skills block.
Guides users through GitHub, GitLab, local Markdown, or custom issue tracker choices.
Drafts docs/agents files for issue tracker rules, triage labels, and domain docs.
Maps five canonical triage roles to repository-specific label names.
Documents single-context and multi-context domain documentation layouts.
Uses seed templates for GitHub, GitLab, local Markdown, labels, and domain guidance.
limitations: Requires user confirmation before writing setup files.
Does not create issue tracker labels or authenticate CLI tools.
Does not replace project-specific domain documentation.
Custom trackers require the user to describe the workflow.

use_cases.title: Prepare a New Repository
use_cases.description: Set up agent-readable issue tracker, triage, and domain documentation rules before using engineering skills.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Agent Context
use_cases.description: Create shared setup files so agents and teammates use the same labels and documentation paths.

use_cases.title: Adapt Existing Workflows
use_cases.description: Record GitHub, GitLab, local Markdown, or custom tracker conventions without changing the tracker itself.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a repository with unknown conventions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up this repository for Matt Pocock engineering skills. Inspect existing agent docs, issue tracking, labels, and domain docs. Ask before writing.

prompt_templates.title: GitHub Defaults
prompt_templates.scenario: Use the common GitHub Issues path with standard labels.
prompt_templates.prompt: Configure this repository for GitHub Issues with the default triage labels. Draft the agent skills block and docs files for review.

prompt_templates.title: Local Markdown Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Use local files instead of hosted issue tracking.
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up local Markdown issues under .scratch for this repository. Keep triage labels and domain doc rules clear for future skills.

prompt_templates.title: Custom Tracker Migration
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced setup for teams using Jira, Linear, or another tracker.
prompt_templates.prompt: Configure agent skills for our custom issue tracker. Capture my workflow, map our triage states, and document any domain docs layout differences.

output_examples.input: Set up agent skills for a GitHub repository with default labels.
output_examples.output: A setup summary explaining the selected GitHub workflow, default label mapping, and created agent documentation files.

output_examples.input: Use local Markdown issues and a multi-context domain layout.
output_examples.output: A draft that records local issue files, triage status rules, and how agents should find each context document.

output_examples.input: We use a custom tracker with different label names.
output_examples.output: A documented tracker workflow and label mapping that other engineering skills can follow consistently.

best_practices: Run the skill before using issue, triage, PRD, testing, or architecture skills.
Review the drafted files before allowing writes to repository documentation.
Update docs/agents files when issue tracker or label conventions change.
anti_patterns: Do not run it without checking whether CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md already exists.
Do not accept default labels if your tracker already uses different names.
Do not use custom tracker setup without a clear written workflow from the user.

faq.question: Does this skill create GitHub or GitLab issues?
faq.answer: No. It documents which tracker future skills should use and how they should use it.

faq.question: Can it work without GitHub?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports GitLab, local Markdown issues, and custom tracker descriptions.

faq.question: Will it overwrite existing agent instructions?
faq.answer: It is designed to update an existing Agent skills block in place and avoid duplicate sections.

faq.question: What files does it create or update?
faq.answer: It updates CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md and writes issue tracker, triage label, and domain docs under docs/agents.

faq.question: Why does it ask about triage labels?
faq.answer: Future triage workflows need the exact label names already used by your repository or tracker.

faq.question: When should I rerun it?
faq.answer: Rerun it when you switch issue trackers, rename triage labels, or reorganize domain documentation.
